thread:
anna_ml: starting Deckard-12B bring-up: objective is perf sweep + quant quality check. ctx lens 512/2048/8192, batch sizes 1/2/4/8, modes fp16/int8/qat. keeping interactive SLO target p50<25ms p99<120ms at ctx=2048 batch=1.

sam_perf: noted. will prioritize tail latency runs. do we want continuous batching on for any profiles? :question:

anna_ml: run both. compare --continuous-batching=true/false. also capture kv cache stats and kernel-switch traces.

jordan_infra: prewarming nodes now, enabling kv-cache prefetch on the clusters used (us-west-2 gpu-pool). command:
```
./infractl warmup --pool deckard-warm --nodes 3 --kv-prefetch
```
Logs ok. pinning workloads to nodes to avoid noisy neighbors.

benchbot: kickoff accepted, run_id=deckard_2024_12_05_01. will post interim updates. :gear:

benchbot: interim: int8 ctx=512 batch=4 continuous=true => throughput=448 tok/s p50=16ms p99=86ms kv_hit=0.89

sam_perf: nice throughput. please also try batcher_window sweep 20/40/80ms for int8 ctx=2048 batch=1. i suspect tail can tighten with larger window.

anna_ml: adding flags: --batcher-window=20/40/80 --trace=attention,kernel-swap. also tying regression eval to int8 runs.

benchbot: result partial: int8 ctx=2048 batch=1 window=20ms => throughput=94 tok/s p50=21ms p99=131ms

marta_research: int8 p99 looks above SLO. pulling sample traces to see if attention kernel swap or cache miss. also queueing A/B regression subset to run against int8.

jordan_infra: repro with kv-prefetch off to rule out stale cache effects; relaunching with same seed. also bumped qos to realtime for these nodes.

benchbot: run complete: id=deckard_2024_12_05_01 summary:
- fp16 ctx=2048 batch=1 continuous=false => throughput=88 tok/s p50=23ms p99=116ms
- int8 ctx=2048 batch=1 continuous=false window=40ms => throughput=96 tok/s p50=20ms p99=124ms
- int8 ctx=2048 batch=1 continuous=true window=80ms => throughput=105 tok/s p50=19ms p99=119ms
- qat ctx=2048 batch=1 => throughput=92 tok/s p50=21ms p99=122ms
- int8 ctx=512 batch=4 => throughput=460 tok/s p50=15ms p99=82ms
Artifacts: s3://redwood-perf/deckard/deckard_2024_12_05_01.tar.gz

marta_research: traces show occasional kernel fallback at timestep ~slice 230 leading to 10-30ms spikes. looks like attention kernel selection heuristic toggles for long sequences. filing an issue with runtime team.

sam_perf: takeaways: continuous batching + larger window improved throughput and tightened tail a bit. still seeing int8 p99 regressions vs fp16 in some runs. next: run fixed RNG seeds x3 and capture kernel trace per-run.

anna_ml: action items:
- sam: run seed sweep x3 for int8 ctx=2048 batch=1 window=80ms (attach traces)
- jordan: try runtime flag to force kernel choice for attention to avoid fallback (if available)
- marta: run regression eval A/B on int8 artifacts and report any quality deltas >1%
I'll post a short summary to #docs once we have seeded runs. thanks all :tada:
